The average gasoline price declined in July to $3.95, from $4.05 in June, according to AAA.

Consumer sentiment improved in July as gasoline prices cooled, according to the final results of the University of Michigan’s monthly survey.

The survey’s sentiment index rose to 55.2 in July, from 49.5 in June. An initial reading earlier this month landed at 54.4.
